scope: Known pilot category hypotheses; no instance coordinates or scoring references

bottle.up: From the broad base toward the narrow neck and cap or mouth. A missing broad base in a scan is not the bottle mouth.

bowl.up: From the small bottom toward the wide open rim; the concave interior opens upward.

can.up: From the bottom toward the lid or pull-tab. If both ends are indistinguishable, abstain; axial shape alone cannot establish the sign.

camera.up: The normal operating upright orientation: controls and shutter button above, tripod/base below; do not use the lens axis as up.
camera.front: Horizontally outward through the lens, toward the photographed subject.

laptop.up: Keyboard/base rests below, screen extends upward from its hinge; screen normal is not up.
laptop.front: Horizontally from the screen hinge toward the front keyboard edge and seated user.

mug.up: From the closed base toward the open rim, with the cavity opening upward.
mug.front: Horizontally from the cup body toward the center of the handle. This is the project reference convention, not a claim that a mug has a universal front.
